career_ladder.note: Village Field Assistants (VFA) work in the Land Revenue Department of the Government of Kerala at the grass-root village office level, assisting the Village Officer in land records maintenance, basic tax collection, field inspections, and revenue certificates. The career progression advances through Senior VFA / Village Assistant, Village Officer / Revenue Inspector, Deputy Tahsildar, and Tahsildar upon passing the Revenue Test and Account Tests conducted by Kerala PSC.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Village Field Assistant is conducted on a district-wise basis across all 14 revenue districts in Kerala through a two-stage examination process: Common Tenth Level Preliminary Examination (Objective OMR screening test carrying 100 marks) followed by the District-wise Main Written Examination (Objective OMR carrying 100 marks). Final district-wise ranked lists are prepared strictly on the basis of marks scored in the Main Examination.

financial_package.note: Village Field Assistants in the Kerala Land Revenue Department are paid under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) at Pay Scale ₹23,000 - ₹50,200 with entry basic pay of ₹23,000.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification Cat. No. 368/2021 & Kerala Government 11th Pay Revision Order
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹23,000 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹13,340) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A Corporation ₹2,300, Class B Municipalities ₹1,500, Class C Panchayats ₹1,000) and medical allowance (₹500/month); net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹3,634), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government quarters allotment or House Rent Allowance based on district posting
Cashless hospitalization coverage under the Kerala Government MEDISEP scheme
Field duty travel allowance (TA) and survey inspection allowances under KSR
Onam festival bonus / special advance as per annual government orders
Departmental welfare fund and credit cooperative society benefits
